reason: The coordinator's decision of 2026-11-24 for the 2.0.6 release (PR #652), made for the owner: the short rung of the Clean Home recording's range reading is the range word this language already ships for the same reading (riding_label_range_volt_short and riding_label_range_scooter_short «Autonomia»), matching the full rung «Autonomia estim.» that the council judged and the judge confirmed. Width: «Autonomia» measures about 66.2 dp at 13 sp. The English budget was 64 dp, the narrowest case (a 280 dp window, large text, dual units), so all three drafts failed it and the judge fell back to English, naming this word as the wanted text; the budget is now 68dp@13sp. In that narrowest case the label can lose about one letter to an ellipsis, a cut-off the owner accepts at very large text. The only passing alternatives stay refused: «Alcance» is Bluetooth reach in this app, and «Auton.» is not an approved abbreviation on its own.
